chunks: They will surely perish who kill their offspring in ignorance foolhardily, and forbid the food that God has given them by fabricating lies against God. Misguided are they surely, and will never come to guidance.
ai.seo_question: Who are the people that will surely perish according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as addressing both the pre-Islamic Arabs who sacrificed children to idols and the broader community of believers who neglected religious duties due to ignorance. It highlights the dual error of 'safa' (foolishness) in action and 'iftira'' (fabrication) in belief, serving as a critique of those who distort divine sustenance and guidance. The verse underscores the consequence of deviating from true knowledge, a central theme in Shia scholarship regarding the necessity of understanding divine will.
